name: gate-parallel-memory-isobmff-aarch64
reason: Memory of ISO BMFF with the kernel RSS bound, 30 pairs, once on one CPU and once on CPUs 1-15, on Linux AArch64 on a c6g.4xlarge at a92f2d0a: every case's peak heap identical sample for sample, candidate and reference resident medians within the serial spread, every case passing both ways; with the per-case comparison and verdicts, the step logs, the RSS module proof, and the source bundle
